units.source_text: 与那份热情的相比，男人的动作是缓慢的，像是被沙子吸住了似的。

en.t: Compared with that intensity, the man's movements were slow, as if the sand had sucked him in.

units.source_text: 这时，女人已经回过头来，斜斜地拄着铁锹，呆呆地盯着男人看。

en.t: By then, the woman had already turned around and was leaning at an angle on her shovel, staring blankly at the man.
